description:
Send a reply in a conversation.

The reply is sent through the original channel (e.g., Instagram comment, X reply, Facebook comment, etc.).

Replies require conversation reply routing metadata (credential + operation). Provide "routing" once and it will be stored on the conversation for future replies.

Use the Inbox Reply agent to get AI-drafted replies with brand voice.

routing.description: Optional: set conversation reply routing (persisted on conversations.metadata.replyRouting). Use this when the conversation doesn't yet have reply routing configured.

baseInput.description: Static input merged into every reply (e.g. channel/thread identifiers)

operation.description: Connector operation name to execute (e.g. send_message)

name: reply_to_conversation
title: Reply to Conversation
